definitions.gloss: snap decision; prompt judgment; quick decision
definitions.explanation: Making a decision immediately without lengthy deliberation. Can be viewed positively (decisive action) or negatively (hasty judgment) depending on context.

examples.japanese: {即断|そくだん}⟦{即決|そっけつ}→即決：18490_sokketsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I decided on the spot without hesitation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即断|そくだん}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't make an immediate decision on this matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即断|そくだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The president is someone who makes quick decisions, so meetings never drag on.

notes:
USAGE:
Often paired with ⟦{即決|そっけつ}→即決：18490_sokketsu⟧ in the four-character expression {即断即決|そくだんそっけつ} (making snap decisions and acting on them immediately). Whether {即断|そくだん} is positive or negative depends on context — it can mean decisiveness or rashness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即断|そくだん}⟦{即決|そっけつ}→即決：18490_sokketsu⟧ (snap decision and immediate action)
- {即断|そくだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to decide on the spot)
- {即断|そくだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁物|きんもつ}→禁物：13738_kinmotsu⟧ (snap decisions are to be avoided)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{即決|そっけつ}→即決：18490_sokketsu⟧: immediate decision — very similar, often paired with {即断|そくだん}
- ⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧: determination, resolution — a deliberate, weighty decision
